text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Goddess of Victory might not have
blessed
me with her smile today...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But everyone had lots of fun, and that's
good
enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that means I was able to
bring some
extra sparkle to the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Is that how you see me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As an entertainer, I can't afford to be
outshone
by anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'll show everyone a good time at
my next
race too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm not satisfied with my

performance today either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's expecting much more than
this from
me, and I'll have to work
harder to meet those
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, everyone! I'll only get
stronger from
here on out!
